name: DatePicker
summary: One date, typed in the locale's order or chosen from the Calendar in a popover under the box. Typing is checked when the person leaves the box or presses Enter: a date it can't read, or one outside the limits, keeps the text and says what to type. Not for a date someone knows by heart, such as a birth date (type it in three NumberFields), or a range (DateRangePicker).
a11y: A native text input named by the Field label; the pattern is in the hint. The calendar button ("Choose a date") has `aria-haspopup="dialog"`; the popover is a dialog named by the label, focus goes to the chosen day (or today), and Escape or choosing a day closes it and returns focus to the box.

props.name: label
props.description: A noun phrase naming the date: "Delivery date".

props.name: onChange
props.description: A day was chosen or typed (`yyyy-mm-dd`), or the box was emptied (null).

props.name: hint
props.description: One short sentence; the pattern to type ("dd/mm/yyyy") is said after it.

props.name: error
props.description: What is wrong and how to fix it; replaces the picker's own typing messages.
